items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I can't know who he's talking about. He may be referring to George Augustine, that was the bass player.

ctx.x: Your father, a month ago, mentioned something about this Mr. Augustine. Do you remember?
I can't know who he's talking about. He may be referring to George Augustine, that was the bass player.
I think he did mention he was a bass player, but I don't remember now if he played with him or studied something with him or what it was.
